name: Request readings
func:
// [device, value] pairs to read every 30 seconds
const wanted = [
    // Outdoor unit (hmux0)
    ['hmux0', 'RunDataElectricPowerConsumption'], // electricity in (W)
    ['hmux0', 'BuildingCircuitFlow'],             // water flow (l/h)
    ['hmux0', 'RunDataFlowTemp'],                 // water out (°C)
    ['hmux0', 'RunDataReturnTemp'],               // water back (°C)
    ['hmux0', 'RunDataAirInletTemp'],             // outdoor air in (°C)
    ['hmux0', 'RunDataCompressorSpeed'],
    ['hmux0', 'CurrentCompressorUtil'],           // compressor output (%)
    ['hmux0', 'RunDataHighPressure'],             // refrigerant pressure (bar)
    ['hmux0', 'RunDataBuildingCPumpPower'],       // pump speed (%)
    ['hmux0', 'RunStats4PortValveSwitches'],      // defrost counter
    ['hmux0', 'CompressorStarts'],
        ['hmux0', 'Currenterror'],                    // fault codes, e.g. 283
    ['hmux0', 'YieldHcDay'],                      // heat to house today (kWh)
    ['hmux0', 'YieldHwcDay'],                     // heat to hot water today (kWh)
    ['hmux0', 'CopHcMonth'],
    // Controller (ctlv3)
    ['ctlv3', 'Hc1ActualFlowTempDesired'],        // target flow (°C)
    ['ctlv3', 'Hc1Status'],                       // heating active (1/0)
    ['ctlv3', 'Hc1PumpStatus'],
    ['ctlv3', 'Z1ValveStatus'],
    ['ctlv3', 'HwcStorageTemp'],                  // cylinder (°C)
    ['ctlv3', 'HwcTempDesired'],
    ['ctlv3', 'OutsideTempAvg'],
    ['ctlv3', 'PrEnergySumHc'],                   // electricity for heating, total (kWh)
    ['ctlv3', 'PrEnergySumHwc']                   // electricity for hot water, total (kWh)
];

flow.set('ebusd_wanted', wanted.map(([dev, name]) => `${dev}/${name}`));

return [wanted.map(([dev, name]) => ({ topic: `ebusd/${dev}/${name}/get`, payload: '' }))];
